identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Neon Noir' tech-style coupon platform that feels like a cyberpunk marketplace, not a spreadsheet.

headings.usage: All section titles, brand names, and hero text. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

glassmorphism.default: backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: rgba(18, 20, 28, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
glassmorphism.heavy: backdrop-filter: blur(24px); background: rgba(11, 12, 21, 0.85); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

HeroSlider.description: Full-width immersive slider with neon city vibes.
HeroSlider.specs: Height: 60vh (mobile) / 70vh (desktop). Content: Bottom-left aligned text with glassmorphic backing.
HeroSlider.animation: Parallax effect on scroll. Fade transition between slides.

BrandCard.description: Minimalist logo container that glows on hover.
BrandCard.specs: Aspect ratio 1:1 or 4:3. Centered logo. Background: Dark Grey (#181823). Border: 1px solid transparent (gradient on hover).
BrandCard.interaction: Scale up 1.05 on hover. Border lights up with primary gradient.

CouponCard.description: Digital ticket metaphor with a 'tear-off' section.
CouponCard.specs: Left side: Brand info & Discount amount. Right side: Action button (Get Code). Separator: Dashed vertical line with semi-circle cutouts.

Tabs.description: Floating pill tabs or Underline tabs with sliding indicator.
Tabs.specs: Active state: Text gradient + Bottom border (or full pill background). Inactive: Text grey.
Tabs.animation: Framer Motion 'layoutId' for smooth sliding background/underline.

Search.specs: Large input field with search icon. Real-time filtering. Glassmorphic dropdown results.
Search.location: Sticky header or prominent hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Implement the 'Neon Noir' color palette in 'tailwind.config.js' extending the theme. Do NOT overwrite standard colors, EXTEND them.
3. FONTS: Import 'Outfit' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
4. COMPONENTS: Build the 'CouponCard' with CSS masks for the 'ticket cutout' effect. This is a signature E1 move.
5. GRADIENTS: Use the primary gradient (Purple->Pink) for all primary CTAs and active states.
6. MOBILE: Ensure touch targets are at least 44px. Use bottom sheet drawers (Shadcn Drawer) for filters on mobile.
7. ADMIN: Keep the admin panel simple but use the same dark theme. Don't make it look like a boring dashboard. Use the 'Glassmorphism' cards for stats.
8. TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8). Avoid cramped layouts.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast is high. Use 'aria-label' for icon-only buttons.
